instruction: How long is my shortest Spotify playlist, in minutes, rounded to the nearest number?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so all actions are lookups and the only goal besides (task-completed) is that every song's duration has been retrieved. The number of playlists/songs is unknown a priori, so the problem uses a representative library of 2 playlists with 2 songs each (in-playlist facts are structural existence facts, ids become usable only after show_playlist_library / show_playlist). To force exhaustive inspection in pure STRIPS (no quantified or conditional constructs), songs carry a static inspection order (next-song) and a cursor predicate (ready) that is advanced by spotify-show-song; the last song points to itself so the single show-song action stays uniform, and (not (known-duration ?s)) prevents repeats. supervisor-complete-task takes the answer object (API arg) plus the last song as a task-record parameter so its precondition entails all durations are known. supervisor.show_profile is modeled because the reference solution reads the login username (email) from it; the username object is bound to the supervisor's known email. The answer value is computed at runtime by the agent as round(min playlist total duration / 60).
